Title: 1. Rear Window
description: A bored photographer recovering from a broken leg passes the time by watching his neighbors and begins to suspect one of them of murder.

Title: 2. The Caine Mutiny
description: When a U.S. Naval captain shows signs of mental instability that jeopardises the ship, the first officer is urged to consider relieving him of command.

Title: 3. A Star Is Born
description: A fading matinee idol helps a young singer and actress find fame, even as age and alcoholism send his own career on a downward spiral.

Title: 4. White Christmas
description: A successful song-and-dance team become romantically involved with a sister act and team up to save the failing Vermont inn of their former commanding general.

Title: 5. Seven Samurai
description: Farmers from a village exploited by bandits hire a veteran samurai for protection, and he gathers six other samurai to join him.

Title: 6. Godzilla
description: After a dinosaur-like beast - awoken from undersea hibernation by atom bomb testing - ravages Tokyo, a scientist must decide if his similarly dangerous weapon should be used to destroy it.

Title: 7. Touchez pas au grisbi
description: An aging, world-weary gangster is double-crossed and forced out of retirement when his best friend is kidnapped and their stash of eight stolen gold bars demanded as ransom.

Title: 8. Senso
description: An Italian Countess is allied with Nationalists during the Italian-Austrian war of unification. However, she risks betraying their cause when she falls in love with an Austrian lieutenant.

Title: 9. Dial M for Murder
description: A jealous former tennis player plots the perfect murder of his wealthy wife in their London flat, triggering a tense trap of betrayal and evidence.

Title: 10. On the Waterfront
description: An ex-prize fighter turned New Jersey longshoreman struggles to stand up to his corrupt union bosses, including his older brother, as he starts to connect with the grieving sister of one of the syndicate's victims.

Title: 11. Sabrina
description: After her return from school in Paris, a playboy finally takes notice of his family's chauffeur's daughter, who's long had a crush on him, but he questions his more serious brother's motives when he warns against getting involved with her.

Title: 12. Creature from the Black Lagoon
description: A strange prehistoric beast lurks in the depths of the Amazonian jungle. A group of scientists try to capture the animal and bring it back to civilization for study.

Title: 13. La Strada
description: A care-free girl is sold to a traveling entertainer, consequently enduring physical and emotional pain along the way.

Title: 14. Saskatchewan
description: In 1877 Western Canada, a police inspector revolts against his inept commander, taking a safer route to the U.S. border in order to stop invading hostile Indians.

Title: 15. 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
description: A ship sent to investigate a wave of mysterious sinkings encounters the advanced submarine, the Nautilus, commanded by Captain Nemo.

Title: 16. Them!
description: The earliest atomic tests in New Mexico cause common ants to mutate into giant man-eating monsters that threaten civilization.

Title: 17. Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
description: When a backwoodsman in 1850s Oregon brings a wife home to his farm, his six brothers decide that they want to get married too, whether the women are willing or not.

Title: 18. Animal Farm
description: A successful farmyard revolution by the resident animals vs. the farmer goes horribly wrong when the victors create a new tyranny among themselves.

Title: 19. Sansho the Bailiff
description: In medieval Japan, a compassionate governor is sent into exile. His wife and children try to join him, but are separated, and the children grow up amid suffering and oppression.

Title: 20. Journey to Italy
description: An unhappily married couple attempts to find direction and insight while vacationing in Naples.

Title: 21. Johnny Guitar
description: After helping a wounded gang member, a strong-willed female saloon owner is wrongly suspected of murder and bank robbery by a lynch mob.

Title: 22. Ulysses
description: A movie adaptation of Homer's second epic, that depicts Ulysses' efforts to return to his home after the end of ten years of war.

Title: 23. Executive Suite
description: When the head of a large manufacturing firm dies suddenly from a stroke, his vice presidents vie to see who will replace him.

Title: 24. Hobson's Choice
description: Widower Henry Hobson refuses to let his three daughters get married because he doesn't want to pay settlements, so they'll just have to outsmart him.

Title: 25. Vera Cruz
description: During the Mexican Rebellion of 1866, an unsavory group of American adventurers are hired by the forces of Emperor Maximilian to escort a countess to Vera Cruz.

Title: 26. An Inspector Calls
description: A wealthy family is visited by a police inspector who questions them about the suicide of a young working class woman.

Title: 27. The Mad Magician
description: An illusionist becomes homicidal when his best kept magic secrets are stolen by his rival.

Title: 28. Black Widow
description: An aspiring young writer insinuates herself into the life of a Broadway producer only to meet an unexpected fate.

Title: 29. There's No Business Like Show Business
description: A blonde beauty upsets a show business family.

Title: 30. It Should Happen to You
description: After a struggling actress in her early thirties with dreams of becoming a star rents a billboard to advertise herself, her life begins to change overnight.

Title: 31. A Lesson in Love
description: After a 15-year marriage, the spouses are going to divorce, but suddenly find out that their feelings have not vanished yet.

Title: 32. The Barefoot Contessa
description: The life of a Hollywood film star is recalled by the different men who knew, worked with, and loved her.

Title: 33. Three Coins in the Fountain
description: Three American women working in Rome, Italy share a spacious apartment and the desire to find love and marriage. Each one experiences a few bumps in her journey to romance.

Title: 34. River of No Return
description: The titular river unites a farmer recently released from prison, his young son and an ambitious saloon singer. In order to survive, each must be purged of anger, and each must learn to understand and care for the others.

Title: 35. The Egyptian
description: In ancient Egypt, a poor orphan becomes a genial physician and is eventually appointed at the Pharaoh's court where he witnesses palace intrigues and learns dangerous royal secrets.

Title: 36. Loophole
description: A bank teller attempts to clear his name and rebuild his career after he is wrongly accused of theft.

Title: 37. Secret of the Incas
description: An adventurer searchers for hidden treasure in the Peruvian jungles.

Title: 38. The Country Girl
description: A director hires an alcoholic has-been and strikes up a stormy relationship with the actor's wife, who he believes is the cause of all the man's problems.

Title: 39. The Glenn Miller Story
description: Biography of bandleader Glenn Miller from his beginnings to his death over the English Channel in December 1944.

Title: 40. Carmen Jones
description: Contemporary version of the Bizet opera, with new lyrics and an African-American cast.

Title: 41. Suddenly
description: In the city of Suddenly, three gangsters trap the Benson family in their own house, on the top of a hill nearby the railroad station, with the intention of killing the president of the USA.

Title: 42. The Belles of St. Trinian's
description: The schoolgirls of St. Trinian's are more interested in racing forms than books; as they try to get rich quick, they are abetted by the headmistress' brother.

Title: 43. Salt of the Earth
description: Mexican workers at a zinc mine call a general strike. It is only through the solidarity of the workers, and importantly the indomitable resolve of their wives, mothers, and daughters, that they eventually triumph.

Title: 44. Demetrius and the Gladiators
description: In first-century Rome, Christian slave Demetrius is sent to fight in the gladiatorial arena and Emperor Caligula seeks Jesus' robe for its alleged magical powers.

Title: 45. Silver Lode
description: In the western town of Silver Lode, Dan Ballard is arrested for murder and theft by marshals, but he denies the charges and searches for the real culprit as the townsfolk gradually turn against him.

Title: 46. Devil Girl from Mars
description: An uptight, leather-clad female alien, armed with a ray gun and accompanied by a menacing robot, comes to Earth to collect Earth's men as breeding stock.

Title: 47. Drum Beat
description: In 1872, Indian fighter Johnny MacKay is appointed peace commissioner for the California and Oregon territory but he faces tough opposition from the renegade Modocs led by their chief Captain Jack.

Title: 48. Riot in Cell Block 11
description: Fed up with the inhumane prison living conditions, a general prison riot breaks out, leading to hostage-taking, a stand-off with the guards and eventual negotiations with the prison administration officials.

Title: 49. The Snow Creature
description: American botanical expedition in the Himalayas stumbles across a Yeti den, capture one and transport it back to Los Angeles, where it escapes while customs officials are debating whether it is animal or human.

Title: 50. Blackout
description: A broke American in London meets a woman who offers to pay him for a marriage of convenience. He agrees, but awakes bloodied in a strange place, having unknowingly become entangled in her father's murder.

Title: 51. The Saracen Blade
description: In 13th century Italy, a peasant exacts justice for the murder of his father by an evil count and his son.

Title: 52. The Law vs. Billy the Kid
description: Billy the Kid is forced to kill for the woman he loves, and is ultimately brought to justice by his old friend Pat Garrett.

Title: 53. Brigadoon
description: Two Americans on a hunting trip in Scotland become lost. They encounter a small village not on the map, Brigadoon, in which people harbor a mysterious secret and behave as if they were still living 200 years in the past.

Title: 54. The Far Country
description: A self-minded adventurer locks horns with a crooked lawman while driving cattle to Dawson.

Title: 55. The High and the Mighty
description: When a commercial airliner develops engine problems on a trans-Pacific flight and the pilot loses his nerve, it is up to the washed-up co-pilot Dan Roman to bring the plane in safely.

Title: 56. Riding Shotgun
description: When a stagecoach guard tries to warn a town of an imminent raid by a band of outlaws, the people mistake him for one of the gang

Title: 57. Ride Clear of Diablo
description: After his father and brother are murdered by a corrupt lawyer and sheriff duo, railroad surveyor Clay O'Mara plans his revenge, and is aided by former outlaw Whitey Kincade.

Title: 58. Private Hell 36
description: When 2 detectives steal $80,000 from a dead robber, one of them suffers from a guilty conscience which could lead to murder.

Title: 59. The Master Plan
description: A Cold War era espionage thriller, about the leaking of secrets at a German facility shared by the Americans and the British.

Title: 60. Samurai I: Musashi Miyamoto
description: Depicts the early life of the legendary warrior Musashi Miyamoto; his years as an aspiring warrior, an outlaw and finally a true samurai.

Title: 61. The Naked Jungle
description: The Leiningen South American cocoa plantation is threatened by a 2-mile-wide, 20-mile-long column of army ants.

Title: 62. Phffft
description: While pursuing new love interests, a former married couple keep running into each other all over town.

Title: 63. The Long, Long Trailer
description: Nicky and Tacy are going to be married. Nicky wants to save up money for a house, but Tacy dreams of starting off with their own home on wheels--a trailer.

Title: 64. The Bridges at Toko-Ri
description: During the Korean War, a Navy fighter pilot must come to terms with his own ambivalence towards the war and the fear of having to bomb a set of highly defended bridges.

Title: 65. Pushover
description: An unethical undercover police officer falls for the beautiful moll of a bank robber on the lam and together they plan to double-cross both the hood and the authorities.

Title: 66. Dragnet
description: Two homicide detectives investigate the brutal shotgun murder of a crime syndicate member.

Title: 67. The Last Time I Saw Paris
description: An American journalist returns to Paris - a city that gave him true love and deep grief.

Title: 68. What Every Woman Wants
description: A newly wed couple have no option to move in with parents.Whilst trying to maintain their relationship without any privacy.

Title: 69. Garden of Evil
description: A trio of American adventurers marooned in rural Mexico are recruited by a beautiful woman to rescue her husband trapped in a cave in Apache territory.

Title: 70. Magnificent Obsession
description: A rich playboy whose recklessness inadvertently causes the death of a prominent doctor tries to make amends to his widow, and falls for her in the process.

Title: 71. Witness to Murder
description: A woman's sanity comes into question after she claims to have witnessed a murder from her apartment window.

Title: 72. Young at Heart
description: The life of the youngest of three sisters in a musical family is complicated by the separate arrivals of a charming composer and a cynical music arranger.

Title: 73. The Purple Plain
description: In World War II Burma, a Canadian bomber pilot becomes reckless after losing his bride in a Luftwaffe air raid.

Title: 74. Man with a Million
description: As part of a bet, two aristocrats offer a penniless American a loan, without telling him that the amount is £1,000,000 in the form of a single banknote.

Title: 75. Prince Valiant
description: A young Viking prince strives to become a knight in King Arthur's Court and restore his exiled father to his rightful throne.

Title: 76. The Black Shield of Falworth
description: Peasant Myles Falworth is trained for knighthood and is groomed by various nobles to defeat the evil Earl of Alban who's plotting to usurp King Henry IV's throne.

Title: 77. Baap Beti
description: New student Meena faces bullying at girls boarding school when she receives no letters from her father, whom she's never met. A kind clerk helps by writing fake letters, but complications arise when classmates demand to meet him.

Title: 78. Sitting Bull
description: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks.

Title: 79. Désirée
description: Desiree Clary falls for Napoleon but marries Bernadotte, while Josephine weds Napoleon to become Empress before being dismissed for not producing an heir.

Title: 80. The Fast and the Furious
description: A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.

Title: 81. Garden of Eden
description: War widow and pre-teen daughter leave home of tyrannical father-in-law in Florida, get lost on a detour, and find shelter at a nudist camp.

Title: 82. Human Desire
description: A Korean War vet returns to his job as a railroad engineer and becomes involved in an affair with a co-worker's wife following a murder on a train where they meet.

Title: 83. Robinson Crusoe
description: The classic story of Robinson Crusoe, a man who is dragged to a desert island after a shipwreck.

Title: 84. Woman's World
description: An executive plans to fill a high-ranking position by interviewing the candidates' wives.

Title: 85. Destry
description: A dishonest mayor and powerful criminal dominate a small western town. But when the town's sheriff dies under mysterious circumstances, Tom Destry, son of a famed gunman, is called in to put an end to the corruption.

Title: 86. Track of the Cat
description: Around the turn of the 20th century, during a harsh northern California winter, members of a ranching family are squabbling among themselves while the two oldest sons go hunting for a panther that is killing their livestock.

Title: 87. Gog
description: A security agent investigates sabotage and murder at a secret underground laboratory, home of two experimental robots.

Title: 88. Apache
description: Refusing to let himself be re-settled on a Florida reservation, Massai, an Apache warrior, escapes his captors and returns to his homeland to become a peaceful farmer.

Title: 89. Hell and High Water
description: During the Cold War, a scientific team refits a Japanese submarine and hires an ex-Navy officer to find a secret Chinese atomic island base and prevent a Communist plot against America that could trigger WW3.

Title: 90. Killers from Space
description: An atomic scientist claims he was abducted by aliens after being injured in a plane crash.

Title: 91. The Good Die Young
description: In London, three otherwise law-abiding good men and their unscrupulous leader are about to commit a serious crime, but for different reasons.

Title: 92. Elephant Walk
description: The young bride of a rich planter finds herself the only white woman at Elephant Walk tea plantation, British Ceylon.

Title: 93. Young and Willing
description: Frank "women in prison" story that sympathetically tracks several inmates through their imprisonment and subsequent return to society. Some are successfully rehabilitated; some are not.

Title: 94. Night People
description: Colonel Steve Van Dyke handles a Cold War swap for a big shot's GI son.

Title: 95. Broken Lance
description: The saga of the Devereaux rancher family, set in 1880's Arizona.

Title: 96. Naked Amazon
description: Exploitation documentary: A white girl is part of an expedition into the dark Amazon jungle. In addition to native nudity (sex) there are animal killings (violence).

Title: 97. Highway Dragnet
description: Wrongly accused of killing a bar-girl he was seen with earlier, a Korean War vet flees from the police in the company of a woman photographer and her young female model.

Title: 98. The Detective
description: Works of art are disappearing, stolen by a master thief, a master of disguise. Father Brown has two goals: to catch the thief and to save his soul.

Title: 99. The Gold of Naples
description: A portrait of the people, the defects, and the peculiarities of Naples in six different vignettes.

Title: 100. Target Earth
description: Giant robots from Venus invade Chicago. Stranded in the deserted city are strangers Frank and Nora.

Title: 101. The Silver Chalice
description: A silversmith journeys to Jerusalem and Rome to create Christ's chalice with disciples' faces. Meanwhile, a fraudulent figure uses magic tricks to pose as the Messiah.

Title: 103. They Rode West
description: A young cavalry doctor, against orders, treats very sick Indians who are forced to stay on unhealthy land, which could lead to a war.

Title: 104. Romeo and Juliet
description: In Shakespeare's classic play, the Montagues and Capulets, two families of Renaissance Italy, have hated each other for years, but the son of one family and the daughter of the other fall desperately in love and secretly marry.

Title: 105. Jail Bait
description: Vic Brady draws young Don Gregor into a life of crime. He then blackmails Gregor's plastic surgeon father into fixing up his face so he can evade the cops.

Title: 106. Heat Wave
description: An American writer living in England gets entangled in a scheme by a beautiful blonde to murder her rich husband.

Title: 107. Cry Vengeance
description: Violent ex-cop Vic Barron comes to Ketchikan, Alaska seeking revenge on an old enemy.

Title: 108. A Story from Chikamatsu
description: Ishun is a wealthy but unsympathetic master printer who has wrongly accused his wife and best employee of being lovers. To escape punishment, the accused run away together, but Ishun is certain to be ruined if word gets out.

Title: 109. The Student Prince
description: A prince has a romance with a barmaid before he must give up personal happiness for duty.

Title: 110. Border River
description: A Confederate officer and his men journey to Mexico to buy guns to continue the war effort. A Union officer determines to stop them.

Title: 111. Naked Alibi
description: A chief of police detectives fired for brutality, tries to get evidence on a man suspected of killing 3 of his officers.

Title: 112. Three Cases of Murder
description: A trilogy of fantastic stories involving murder and the supernatural.

Title: 113. The Bounty Hunter
description: A bounty hunter, hired by Pinkerton, trails three unknown murderous train robbers to a town and finds a host of suspects.

Title: 114. Living It Up
description: An unsophisticated stationmaster from provincial New Mexico fraudulently claims that he is dying in order to get an expense-paid dream tour of New York.

Title: 115. The Bowery Boys Meet the Monsters
description: The Bowery Boys enter a creepy house where they engage in slapstick with the Gravesend Family, comprising a creepy butler, two mad scientists, a crazy old woman with a man-eating plant, a savage gorilla, an 8' robot, and a vampiress.

Title: 116. Giorni d'amore
description: A man and a woman would like to get married, but lack the necessary funds for the traditional "big" wedding. Thus they plan to escape to the countryside and "live in sin".

Title: 117. Long John Silver's Return to Treasure Island
description: In this sequel to Treasure Island, Long John hopes to rescue his friend Jim from a rival pirate and return for more treasure.

Title: 118. Monster from the Ocean Floor
description: Julie, an American on vacation in Mexico, spots a giant, one-eyed amoeba rising from the ocean, but when she tries to tell the authorities, no one believes her. She finally teams up with a marine biologist in an attempt to destroy it.

Title: 119. Twenty-Four Eyes
description: Schoolteacher Hisako Oishi forms an emotional bond with her pupils and teaches them various virtues, while at the same time worrying about their future.

Title: 120. The Forty-Niners
description: During California's gold-rush, an undercover marshal, posing as a gunfighter, investigates the murder of another marshal who had been assigned to the region.

Title: 121. Phantom of the Rue Morgue
description: When several women are found mutilated and murdered, the Paris police are baffled as to who the killer may be. All evidence points to Dupin, but soon it becomes apparent that it is someone (or something) stronger and deadlier than a human.

Title: 122. The Blazing Sun
description: A rich landlord floods and destroys a village on purpose to prevent the people living there from making a profit off their crops. What he doesn't know is that his own daughter is in love with Ahmed, a young man from the village.

Title: 123. The Venusian
description: A stranger from Venus lands in Britain and forms a bond with a young American woman. He comes with a warning to Earth's leaders that they must eliminate all nuclear weapons if the peoples of the solar system are to survive.

Title: 124. The Teckman Mystery
description: A biographer researching a book on a pilot who died during the test flight of a new plane falls in love with the pilot's sister. As he uncovers more about the test flight, people connected with the case begin to die.

Title: 125. Black Tuesday
description: Gangster Vincent Canelli and bank robber Peter Manning escape from Death Row minutes before their execution by electric chair.

Title: 126. Lowlands
description: Set in the early part of 20th century Europe, where a dancer becomes the romantic bone of contention between 2 men; a humble shepherd and an imperious marquis.

Title: 127. Shield for Murder
description: When a brutal police detective murders a bookmaker's runner for $25,000 in cash, a deaf mute sees him do it, and now he finds he must kill again to cover his tracks.

Title: 128. Susan Slept Here
description: A Hollywood screenwriter takes in a runaway girl who's more woman than he can handle.

Title: 129. Beau Brummell
description: In 1796, Captain George Bryan "Beau" Brummell of the 10th Royal Hussars Regiment offends the Prince of Wales with his straightforward outspokenness and gets fired from the Army but is chosen as the Prince's personal advisor.

Title: 130. Carnival Story
description: An American carnival in Germany sets the scene for sin, sex and melodrama.

Title: 131. Doctor in the House
description: The trials and tribulations of a group of medical students at St. Swithin's hospital in London, England.

Title: 132. Johnny Dark
description: Automobile engineer Johnny Dark designs a radical new car. After the owner refuses to sponsor the car in a Canada-to-Mexico sports car race, Johnny, with the aid of the owner's granddaughter, steals the car and competes against the favored driver, his ex-buddy.

Title: 133. The Red and the Black
description: It's no holds barred for Julien in pursuit of upward mobility. Although expected to channel career aspirations into the Church of the post- Napoleonic era, his intensely romantic liaisons propel him forward at a pace he cannot control.

Title: 134. The Count of Monte Cristo
description: Edmond Dantes is falsely accused by those jealous of his good fortune, and is sentenced to spend the rest of his life in the notorious island prison, Chateau d'If. While imprisoned, he meets the Abbe Faria, a fellow prisoner whom everyone believes to be mad. The Abbe tells Edmond of a fantastic treasure hidden away on a tiny island, that only he knows the location of. After many years in prison, the old Abbe dies, and Edmond escapes disguised as the dead body. Now free, Edmond must find the treasure the Abbe told him of, so he can use the new-found wealth to exact revenge on those who have wronged him.

Title: 135. Aunt Clara
description: A wealthy old man dies and leaves his holdings--including a brothel, a gambling den, racing greyhounds, and a sleazy bar--to his eccentric niece Clara Hilton (Dame Margaret Rutherford). Clara vows to "clean up" her new establishments, but complications ensue when she visits the crooked gambling den just when it's being raided by the Police.

Title: 136. The Diamond Wizard
description: An American Treasury agent teams up with a Scotland Yard inspector to track down a group of thieves that are creating artificial diamonds out of sugar.

Title: 137. They Who Dare
description: During World War II, British commandos are sent to destroy a Luftwaffe airfield on a Greek island.

Title: 138. Drive a Crooked Road
description: An upright car mechanic falls in love with the girlfriend of a gangster. This forces him to participate in the criminal underworld.

Title: 139. Lease of Life
description: The parson of a small rural community knows he is dying and this makes him reconsider his life so far and what he can still do to help the community.

Title: 140. Dawn at Socorro
description: Gunfighter Brett Wade, diagnosed with tuberculosis, tries to get out of his former life while helping a young woman.

Title: 141. Deep in My Heart
description: Biographic movie about the American composer Sigmund Romberg.

Title: 142. The Unholy Four
description: A man on a fishing trip with three of his friends receives a blow to the head that makes him lose his memory. Three years later it all comes back to him, but on the day it does one of the men who was on the trip with him turns up dead.

Title: 143. An American in Rome
description: Nando Moriconi is a young Italian living in Rome. He is fond for everything coming from the United States. He tries to speak American-English, to wear clothes he thinks Americans wear, to walk like John Wayne, and to eat cornflakes with ketchup - His life is a parody of the real American way of life that he could not get. Nando's not-so-secret dream is to visit the USA, so he climbs up to the Coliseum and threats to commit suicide if the American Embassy does not give him the visa. But at this point Nando is very well known as a 'crazy-for-USA' boy and the troubles he provoked will not help him.

Title: 144. Taza, Son of Cochise
description: When peacemaking Apache chief Cochise dies, the Chiricahua Apaches are torn between following Cochise's peace loving son Taza and following the warlike renegade Apache warrior Geronimo.

Title: 145. The Men of Sherwood Forest
description: In 1194, on his return from the Third Crusade, Richard the Lionheart is taken prisoner in Germany. Disguised as a troubadour, Robin Hood formulates a plan to rescue Richard but he is captured himself.

Title: 146. Valley of the Kings
description: In 1900, in Egypt, archaeologist Mark Brandon is asked by Ann Mercedes to find the tomb of Ra-Hotep but their quest is marred by intrigue, betrayal, murder and danger.

Title: 147. Too Bad She's Bad
description: A kind-hearted taxi driver runs into a glamorous girl and falls in love with her, but she turns out to be a cheap thief.

Title: 148. Knock on Wood
description: Discovering that a ventriloquist is travelling to Zurich, a spy ring hides secret plans in his dummies' heads. When a second spy ring learns of the plans, they descend upon the ventriloquist, causing city-wide pandemonium.

Title: 149. Fear
description: Irene Wagner, the wife of prominent scientist Albert Wagner, finds herself blackmailed about her affair by her lover's jealous ex-girlfriend. The plot, an experiment in causing fear, drives her into a rage.

Title: 150. Before the Deluge
description: Self-centered parents of the 50's targeted by drama in which teenagers panicking after burglary supposed to finance the run from the Third World War.

Title: 151. Gorilla at Large
description: At a carnival called the Garden of Evil, a man is murdered, apparently by a gorilla...or someone in a gorilla suit.

Title: 152. Miseria e nobiltà
description: "Miseria e Nobiltà" tells the story of the humble families of Felice Pasquale and his colleague who are hired by a Marquis who wants to marry the daughter of a rich but simple cook, so they pose as aristocrats.

Title: 153. High and Dry
description: An American businessman in Scotland is conned into shipping a valuable load of cargo to a Scottish island via a coal powered boat.

Title: 154. Cattle Queen of Montana
description: Sierra Nevada Jones must fight a villainous rancher to regain the land that is rightfully hers.

Title: 155. The Sleeping Tiger
description: After a convict breaks into a psychotherapist's home, he agrees to rehabilitation rather than prosecution, but the therapist's wife then becomes infatuated with him.

Title: 156. The Black Knight
description: During King Arthur's time, a sword maker wishes to win Lady Linet's heart but first he must become a noble knight.

Title: 157. Bait
description: A beautiful blonde is caught up in the deadly rivalry for her love between a middle-aged gold miner and his young partner.

Title: 158. Yankee Pasha
description: In 1800, trapper Jason Starbuck falls for Massachusetts girl Roxana but has to rescue her from slavery when sea pirates capture Roxana and sell her to a Moroccan harem.

Title: 159. The Black Glove
description: Newly arrived in Britain, a jet-lagged musician impulsively goes to the apartment of a beautiful blues singer he's just met and hours later is accused of her murder.

Title: 160. The Long Wait
description: An amnesiac finally learns his true identity...as a murder suspect. And he doesn't even know whether he is guilty...

Title: 161. Sign of the Pagan
description: With the Roman Empire divided, Attila the Hun hopes to conquer. In his way are a brave centurion, a beautiful princess...and Christianity.

Title: 162. Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
description: Rich oriental lord Cassim's cheeky servant Ali Baba is sent to buy a desirable girl-slave, but brings back dancer Morgiane with whom he is enamored. When he's part of a caravan robbed by Abdel's 40 thieves, Ali hides in a camel hive and thus learns the secret of Sesame cave. With stolen loot, he buys a residence for himself, Morgiane and his beggar friends. Cassim not only gets him drunk to learn his secret gold source but also plans to rob him at his grand wedding to Morgiane. But Abdel observed them too and invites his 40 robbers.

Title: 163. The Sea Shall Not Have Them
description: In the North Sea in 1944, passengers of a downed Royal Air Force transport aircraft talk about their lives while awaiting rescue in their dinghy.

Title: 164. Make Haste to Live
description: After serving 18 years in prison for a murder he didn't commit, a mobster is paroled and returns to a New Mexico town to exact his revenge on the woman responsible for his conviction.

Title: 165. Tobor the Great
description: A young boy-genius befriends his grandfather's robot, designed as a test pilot for space travel and coveted by foreign spies.

Title: 166. King Richard and the Crusaders
description: While leading the Third Crusade, King Richard the Lionheart battles treachery in his own camp as well as the Saracens and their charismatic leader Emir Hderim Sultan Saladin.

Title: 167. Two Nights with Cleopatra
description: Sophia Loren plays a dual role, as both the sultry Queen of the Nile with a "man-a-night" appetite and a beautiful slave girl who takes her place and is wooed by a bodyguard who thinks she's the real monarch.

Title: 168. Attila
description: Attila, the leader of the barbarian Huns and called by the Romans "The Scourge of God", sweeps onto the Italian peninsula, defeating all of the armies of Rome, until he and his men reach the gates of the city itself.

Title: 169. Southwest Passage
description: The U.S. Cavalry is ordered to test the feasability of camels in the deserts of the Southwest.

Title: 170. Woman of the River
description: **PLOT SPOILER ALERT** When peasant girl Nives is deserted by smuggler Gino Lodi, she betrays him to the police. Police officer Enzo Cinti, who loves Nives, traces her to the Po River cane-fields, where she is working as a cutter to support herself and an infant son, and warns her that Gino has escaped from prison and is seeking revenge. She rejects his offer to protect her. Gino finds Nives, mourning the drowning death of their son. He surrenders himself to the police and then walks at Nives' side in the funeral procession.

Title: 171. Impulse
description: When his wife leaves for a vacation, a man gets into trouble when he gets romantically involved with a nightclub singer who tricks him into thinking he's committed a serious crime.

Title: 172. The River and Death
description: In a backward village where members of two rival families have kept killing each other for generations, a young doctor is expected to avenge his father.

Title: 173. Girl Gang
description: A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.

Title: 174. Victory at Sea
description: A feature-length condensed version of the documentary TV series Victory at Sea (1952).

Title: 175. Royal Affairs in Versailles
description: The history of the palace of Versailles from its founding to the present.

Title: 176. Her Twelve Men
description: An inexperienced female teacher is hired at a private elite school for boys where she raises a few eyebrows among the all-male faculty.

Title: 177. Court Martial
description: A court-martial attempts to find out why, and if, an officer embezzled his unit's funds.

Title: 178. Emil und die Detektive
description: Emil goes to Berlin to see his grandmother with a large amount of money and is offered sweets by a strange man that make him sleep. He wakes up at his stop with no money. It is up to him and a group of children to save the day.

Title: 179. Betrayed
description: A Dutch intelligence officer recruits an Allied woman to act as liaison with dashing Resistance leader "The Scarf" for a British attack on Arnhem.

Title: 180. The Outcast
description: Jet Cosgrave returns home after his father's death to claim the ranch that was stolen from him.

Title: 181. The Siege at Red River
description: Cavalry Captain Simmons attempts to prevent the delivery of Gatling Guns into the hands of hostile Indians.

Title: 182. The Yellow Mountain
description: Frontier drama about two gold prospectors who hope to strike it rich in the mines of Nevada.

Title: 183. Mad About Men
description: Flirtatious mermaid Miranda (Glynis Johns) swaps places with a schoolteacher who has gone on vacation. All is well until she falls in love with a human.

Title: 184. Athena
description: The story about two sisters in love. Everything should be wonderful, but grandfather doesn't approve of his granddaughters' physically underdeveloped fiancés.

Title: 185. Three Hours to Kill
description: Framed for murder, Jim Guthrie barely escapes lynching by the town mob, becomes a wanted fugitive for three years but returns to find the real killer.

Title: 186. The Atomic Kid
description: A uranium prospector is eating a peanut butter sandwich in the desert where atom bomb tests are being done. He becomes radioactive, and helps the FBI break up an enemy spy ring.

Title: 187. The Love Lottery
description: A famous actor moves to an Italian village to escape obsessive fans, but finds himself becoming the prize in an international lottery without his knowledge.

Title: 188. Wuthering Heights
description: A partial retelling of Wuthering Heights in 19th century Mexico.

Title: 189. Casanova's Big Night
description: A meek tailor thinks his wooing will be helped if he assumes the identity of the famous Casanova...who's deeply in debt.

Title: 190. The Miami Story
description: Fed up with the rising crime rate in Miami, the police chief and leading members of the city council hire a former gangster who's gone straight to help eliminate the biggest crime syndicate in the city.

Title: 191. Green Fire
description: In Colombia, mining engineer Rian Mitchell discovers Carrero, the lost emerald mine of the Conquistadors, but has to contend with notorious local bandit El Moro's gang and with coffee planter Catherine Knowland's love.

Title: 192. Hell's Half Acre
description: An American woman goes to Hawaii to search for her husband, MIA since the war, but he's a fugitive from the law and involved in a private feud against his former crime syndicate partners.

Title: 193. Drums Across the River
description: When whites hunger after the gold on Ute Indian land, a bigoted young man finds himself forced into a peacekeeping role.

Title: 194. 3 Ring Circus
description: Jerry and Pete are two friends with no money, looking for some job. They finally find one as workers in a circus, but Jerry has different dreams. He wants to become a clown.

Title: 195. Beachhead
description: In 1943, in the wake of the Allied amphibious landing on the Japanese-held Bougainville Island, four Marines are sent to scout the location of Japanese minefields.

Title: 196. Ring of Fear
description: The Clyde Beatty Circus seems jinxed, falling victim again and again to apparent accidents which are actually the acts of a murderous saboteur. Mystery writer Mickey Spillane comes on the scene to solve the case.

Title: 197. Ma and Pa Kettle at Home
description: Ma and Pa Kettle get the farm in order to help their son Elwin win a scholarship.

Title: 198. True Friends
description: Alexander, Boris and Vasily are three old friends, who now rarely see each other as they are busy with their professional life. They embark on long-planned voyage on a raft down the Volga river, which turns into a series of comical accidents but also strengthens their friendship.

Title: 199. Twist of Fate
description: Johnny Victor, an actress living with Louis Galt on the Riviera, becomes involved with Pierre Clemont and learns he is a dangerous criminal.

Title: 200. Sound of the Mountain
description: An ingratiating bride develops warm ties to her father-in-law while her cold husband blithely slights her for another woman.

Title: 201. Time Is My Enemy
description: A happily-married woman is blackmailed by her first husband, who she wrongly believed was killed in the Blitz.

Title: 202. Four Guns to the Border
description: An outlaw gang on the lam encounters former associate Simon Bhumer and his gorgeous daughter, who's drawn to their leader Cully.

Title: 203. Rogue Cop
description: After witnessing a murder, honest cop Eddie Kelvaney is silenced by gangster Dan Beaumonte, prompting Eddie's brother, Detective Chris Kelvaney, to search for the killer.

Title: 204. Watch Out for Love
description: Salvador acompañado de dos amigos de su padre a los que él llama tios, llegan a una feria en el pueblo, ahi conoce a Ana. Al ganar una apuesta le pagan con una casa hipotecada, para su sorpresa al entrar en ella se da cuenta de que Ana y su madre viven en ella, provocando un enredo divertido con un explosivo final.

Title: 205. Shop Spoiled
description: One day in the lives and loves of the staff in a large department store.

Title: 206. Jivaro
description: A gorgeous American arrives in Brazilian headhunter country seeking her scapegrace fiancé.

Title: 207. A Free Woman
description: A young architect is about to marry a man she barely knows. Determined to find her happiness, she embarks on a series of liaisons.

Title: 208. Caballero a la medida
description: Cantinflas works as a model of tuxedos for a prestigious store. He just has to wander around in the streets, wearing the tuxedo and a big ad, put on his back. The tuxedo allows him to access to exclusive places, where he meets important and rich people. During his free time, Cantinflas is the manager of an amateur boxer, assists an attractive nurser and occasionally helps a priest in the church and running a poor orphanage. However, one day Cantinflas, wearing the tuxedo, meets a rich man, whom falsely believes that our friend is also a millionaire.

Title: 209. Passion
description: In Mexican California, a land feud erupts and murder is committed when rich landowner Don Domingo reneges on an earlier verbal promise made by his father to grant to the tenant Melo family a piece of land.

Title: 210. The Adventures of Hajji Baba
description: In Ispahan, Persia, a barber mistakes an emerald ring as the prize to be delivered to a prince known far and wide, only to realize that a runaway Princess is the real treasure awaited, promising to escort her to her final destination.

Title: 211. The Immature Grain
description: Based on the novel by Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette. Friends since infancy, Philippe and Vinea have always regarded themselves as brother and sister. But as adolescence segues into puberty, the two youngsters fall in love.

Title: 212. Roots
description: Mexican and Latin-American classic. Four independent stories based on writer Francisco Rojas Gonzáles's work, depicting the reality of Mexican indian people: Las Vacas, Nuestra Señora, El Tuerto and La Potranca. In El Tuerto, crosseyed boy is made fun of by his mates. His religious mother asks God to make the boy's eyes equal. The outcome is tragic.

Title: 213. Sie
description: A great love arises between a young drawer and a newspaper editor 's daughter,Céline .

Title: 214. Men of the Fighting Lady
description: Writer James A. Michener hears Korean War stories about a top pilot.

Title: 215. Dangerous Mission
description: A policeman tries to protect a young woman against a hit man, when she flees New York after witnessing a mob killing.

Title: 216. World for Ransom
description: In Singapore, a private detective and the British authorities are on the trail of a crime syndicate that kidnapped a nuclear physicist with the aim of selling him to the highest bidder.

Title: 217. The Raid
description: Confederate escapees plot to raid Vermont town St. Albans, but their leader's reconnaissance is complicated when he becomes involved with a widow and her son.

Title: 218. Duel in the Jungle
description: In Rhodesia, the accidental death of a diamond broker raises suspicions with his American insurer, which sends a claims investigator to clarify the matter.

Title: 219. Hell Below Zero
description: The captain of an Antarctic whaling ship falls overboard in mysterious circumstances and his daughter, aided by a sympathetic American, decides to investigate the accident.

Title: 220. Neapolitan Carousel
description: The life of a family of street singers.

Title: 221. Sindicato de telemirones
description: An unemployed singer devices a plot to become famous on television. He creates a fake "Union of Television Watchers" with the help of a improvised community leader whose followers are so poor they do not even own television sets.

Title: 222. Princess of the Nile
description: In 1249, an Egyptian princess allies herself with the son of the Caliph of Baghdad in order to rid Egypt of its Bedouin invaders.

Title: 223. Let's Make Up
description: A young actress must decide which of two lovers will be her husband. She daydreams about each one to help her decide.

Title: 224. Three Young Texans
description: Two cowhands fall for their boss' daughter but due to a gambling incident one gets involved with 2 hoods in robbing a payroll train.

Title: 225. Hansel and Gretel
description: An "electronic puppet" version of the Humperdinck opera, adapted for children and using spoken dialogue as well as Humperdinck's music.

Title: 226. Tonight's the Night
description: In the Irish village of Rathbarney, the aged squire is killed while hunting. His successor, O'Leary arrives in Rathbarney to take over his dead great uncle's estate.

Title: 227. Down Three Dark Streets
description: An FBI agent investigates the murder of his partner by taking over the 3 cases he was working on, determined to find his killer.

Title: 228. After the Curfew
description: A hero of revolution returns to civilian life to find the new society very different from the ideals he fought for.

Title: 229. Rhapsody
description: Rich beauty Louise Durant follows her violinist lover to conservatory in Zurich. A pianist there falls for her. Violinist prioritizes music over Louise, pianist loves Louise more. She must choose between the two men.

Title: 230. The Black Pirates
description: Pirates searching for treasure take over a small town in Central America where they believe the loot is buried, but discover that a church has been built over the spot. They force the townspeople to dig for it, but there are more surprises in store for them than they counted on.

Title: 231. No Exit
description: Three people who despise each other find themselves sharing a room in Hell - forever.

Title: 232. The Runaway Bus
description: Heavy fog grounds flights at London airport. A group of passengers board an airline bus to reach an alternative airport, hoping to depart from there instead.

Title: 233. Woman of Rome
description: During the fascist era, Adriana a beautiful young model, becomes a prostitute after a love affair gone wrong. She meets Mino, a partisan who falls in love with her and wants to redeem her.

Title: 234. Paladin
description: His Mighty Sword was Pledge to his Queen and the the Woman he loved.

Title: 235. His Majesty O'Keefe
description: A Yankee sea captain has adventures in paradise trying to become an entrepreneur in Micronesia.

Title: 236. The Beachcomber
description: In the Indian Ocean, the new British Resident of the Welcome Islands tangles with loneliness, angry natives, a drunken troublemaker and a sudden outbreak of cholera.

Title: 237. Red Garters
description: A man visits a frontier town seeking to avenge his brother's murder.

Title: 238. Joan of Arc at the Stake
description: Surreal musical about the time of the execution of Joan of Arc.

Title: 239. Crossed Swords
description: Adventurer sets out to save princess' father's kingdom.

Title: 240. The Stranger's Hand
description: A British lad tries to investigate his father's disappearance in Venice after nobody believes him.

Title: 241. Frisky
description: The relationships between a veteran marshal, his bride-to-be, a rookie and his fiancée are severely tested when the young carabiniere is temporarily sent to a distant town.

Title: 242. The Divided Heart
description: A story of litigation between a birth mother and an adopted family due to a child lost during a war.

Title: 243. Bitter Creek
description: A man thinks a wealthy rancher killed his brother, and it's up to him to prove it.

Title: 244. Francis Joins the WACS
description: Peter Stirling (with his old friend the talking mule) is recalled to active duty...in the WACs!

Title: 246. The Rocket Man
description: Wacky complications ensue when a little boy comes into possession of a ray gun that compels anyone caught in its beam to tell the truth. He uses it to prevent his orphanage from being shut down by creditors and to help a cute couple fall in love.

Title: 247. Air of Paris
description: The story of Andre Menard, a promising young amateur boxer from an impoverished background who is mentored by former pro Victor Le Garrec, and whose career path takes a nosedive when he falls for the wealthy Corinne.

Title: 248. Rose Marie
description: Wilderness girl Rose Marie has adventures in life and love when Mountie Mike Malone takes her out of the wild.

Title: 249. Riders to the Stars
description: Three men are assigned by the Office of Scientific Investigation to man rocket ships to outer space and attempt to capture a meteor.

Title: 250. Flesh and the Woman
description: Bankrupt and disbarred, Parisian lawyer Pierre Martel heads for Algiers where he's supposed to rejoin his high-maintenance Italian girlfriend Sylvia but when she fails to show-up a heart-broken Pierre joins the French Foreign Legion.

Title: 251. The Human Jungle
description: Police procedural film about a police captain assigned to take over a demoralized precinct and turn it around by settling all the unsolved cases, as well as some new tough ones.

Title: 252. Paid to Kill
description: A failed business deal forces James Nevill to blackmail his weak-willed friend into murdering him so that his wife can collect his insurance, but circumstances suddenly change.

Title: 253. The Scarlet Web
description: An insurance investigator is framed for murder after a pretty woman hires him to recover a letter from a man who wants to blackmail her.

Title: 254. Eight O'Clock Walk
description: In post-WW2 England, a taxi driver is ostracized by society after he's accused of murdering a school-girl and his untried lawyer must find the real killer to save his client from the hangman.

Title: 255. Crest of the Wave
description: A Navy lieutenant is borrowed by the British to supervise torpedo experiments after one of their scientists is killed.

Title: 256. Orders Are Orders
description: An American movie company wants to shoot a science-fiction film using a British army barracks as a location, and its soldiers as actors.

Title: 257. Ah! The Beautiful Priestesses of Bacchus
description: A small-town policeman is informed that "naked women" are dancing in a revue at a local variety theater. Being the guardian of public morals that he is, he decides to stroll on down there and check it out for himself.

Title: 258. They Were So Young
description: A model agency in Rio de Janeiro is actually a front for a white-slavery ring that kidnaps European women and sells them on the South American sex market.

Title: 259. The Command
description: An Army doctor with no combat experience is forced to take command of a cavalry troop escorting a wagon train through hostile Indian country when the unit's commanding officer dies.

Title: 260. The Story of Vickie
description: After being crowned young Queen Victoria is not amused about the plans of her family and her advisor Lord Melbourne to find her a suitable husband. She leaves for Paris and en route falls in love with a handsome young man.

Title: 261. Riviera
description: Annamaria, an ex-prostitute, takes her young daughter from convent school with her on a summer vacation. She introduces herself like a widow just to be accepted by people in the Italy of the '50s. She is surrounded by new friends and people show to love her. But some days after their arrival in the Italian Riviera, a former client recognizes her and reveals the hidden secret. People immediately become hostile. None wants her in the hotel. Supposed friends disappear. She's isolated. The people's hypocrisy will explode in entire contradiction later, when Annamaria becomes intimate friend with a rich respectable man.

Title: 262. The Lone Gun
description: In Texas, drifter Cruze becomes the marshal of the town of Marlpine but he must face the murderous Moran brothers alone when the scared town refuses to back him up.

Title: 263. The Rainbow Jacket
description: A champion jockey is banned from racing so spends his time helping a young lad to become the next champion.

Title: 264. The Vanishing Prairie
description: Story of the American prairie as it was when vast herds of bison and elk grazed there.

Title: 265. The Angel Who Pawned Her Harp
description: An angel finds that she needs money to fulfill her mission on Earth. Her only solution to this problem is to pawn her harp.

Title: 266. Gypsy Colt
description: A beautiful spirited horse is so devoted to his young mistress that he undertakes an incredible 500-mile journey over treacherous terrain to be reunited with her.

Title: 267. Alaska Seas
description: The owner of a salmon cannery in Alaska hires a man who had formerly been his partner, and comes to regret it.

Title: 268. The Other Woman
description: Feeling humiliated and angry after failing a line reading, an aspiring actress plots to ruin the life and career of the film's director.

Title: 269. Andha Naal
description: After an engineer is shot dead, several people around him relate different versions and the related incidents that may have led to the murder.

Title: 270. About Mrs. Leslie
description: A rooming-house landlady recalls her past in flashbacks.

Title: 271. Lucky Me
description: Four struggling theatrical performers meet a famous songwriter who is trying to convince a wealthy oilman to finance a musical he is scripting, promising them stardom if it comes to fruition.

Title: 272. A Bullet Is Waiting
description: After their small plane crashes in the wilderness, a sheriff's deputy and his prisoner take shelter at an isolated farm.

Title: 273. Con el diablo en el cuerpo
274. Battle of Rogue River
description: In Oregon, the Army is ordered to negotiate peace with the Indians but unscrupulous businessmen, who profiteered during the conflict, secretly sabotage the peace process.

Title: 275. River Beat
description: A London police inspector becomes attracted to a ship's radio operator and discovers smuggled gems. He must arrest her if guilty, protect her from the smuggling gang, and protect her from the silenced gang.

Title: 276. Delayed Action
description: A destitute, suicidal man is offered a contract for 18 months to act as a front for an unscrupulous businessman, with his life being forfeit. He carries out his agreement, also writing a successful novel and falling in love, wanting to break the contract early. He is refused.

Title: 277. Taxi Driver
description: Mangal drives a taxi by day, then drinks at night, listens to his singer girlfriend Sylvie and then goes into a drunken stupor - and wakes up with a hangover. One day, while assisting another taxi driver, Mangal comes to the assistance of a damsel in distress who is being molested by two thugs. Mangal gallants rescues her and attempts to take her to her destination, to no avail, as the person she is looking for has moved. The next day, Mangal and the young woman, Mala, again attempt to seek Ratanlal, a music director, but the entire day is spent in vain. Mala lives in Mangal's tiny apartment and both become attracted to each other. When Mala finds out about Sylvie, she leaves him. He goes in her search, but finds that she has become a famous singer with the help of her music director friend. Will Mangal ever get a chance to tell about his love for Mala? What will Sylvie's reaction be?

Title: 278. Top Banana
description: A filmed version of Phil Silvers' hit Broadway show about a television comic who tried to regain his ratings on TV.

Title: 279. Theodora, Slave Empress
description: Teodora, a Roman courtesan and former slave girl, marries the Roman emperor Justinian and assumes the throne as Empress of Rome. But the divide between nobility and slave is too great. Teodora seeks justice for her people, and revolution and armed conflict erupt in both Byzantium and Rome.

Title: 280. Boot Polish
description: Pre-teen brother and sister, abandoned by their father to be taken care of by an abusive prostitute aunt, survive life in an Indian squatters' camp, aided by a friendly cripple, by learning to shine shoes instead of begging.

Title: 281. The Anatomy of Love
description: A five-part compilation film. In "The Baby," a poverty-ridden couple with children decides that their newborn is too much and decide to leave him in a church, but the mother can't go through with it and decides to leave him in an expensive car; the father cannot go through with that and they take him back home. "The Hand of Providence": An old woman has been brooding for many years while the parish priest has been urging her to unburden herself by telling him all. She tells him that her life seems pointless and that she is thinking of suicide. Trying to dissuade her, the priest trips and falls over the edge of a cliff and saves himself by grasping a hanging bush. This convinces the woman that God holds life precious and she shouldn't give up hers. "On Location": An elderly actor and actress get parts in a film being shot on location and discover that they are old friends. They both confess to being lonely, and while rehearsing their scenes they decide that a future together would be most desirable. They drive off and leave the director needing two actors. "The Amorous Bus Driver": A Neapolitan bus driver does not let company regulations interfere with romance. "The Camera": A woman is after a camera offered as a prize on a chance-board. A man is after her. He borrows the camera to shoot some posed shots with her, but can't make the timer work.

Title: 282. Bengal Brigade
description: Set during British India 1857, Captain Clayboune (Rock Hudson) is faced with restoring his reputation after being harshly disciplined for disobeying orders.

Title: 283. Windfall in Athens
description: On a lazy Athenian Sunday, a young and fresh saleswoman loses her soon-to-be winning lottery ticket, only to meet its handsome new owner. Of course, she wants it back; however, what if fortune and ardent Cupid are already on her doorstep?

Title: 284. Ratha Kanneer
description: The story revolves around Mohanasundaram, a returned-from-abroad, westernized, rich man who shows arrogance and contempt towards anything part of Indian culture and anyone below his social standards.

Title: 285. Charade
description: A husband and wife discuss three incidents that occurred in various situations.

Title: 286. The Shanghai Story
description: In post-WW2 Shanghai, expatriate Westerners are detained in the Waldorf Hotel until the Communists can identify a suspected spy among them but some prisoners try to outwit the interrogators and the armed guards and flee.

Title: 287. The Magic City
description: Kosmas, a young man living in the slums, constantly tries to make ends meet, hoping for a better day. Because of debts, he gets tangled up in smuggling. His morals are tested and he tries to find a way out.

Title: 288. Amar
description: Anju Rai lives a wealthy lifestyle with her widowed dad in a palatial house. She is now of marriageable age, and her dad has arranged her marriage with Advocate Amarnath. Both Anju and Amarnath meet and fall in love with each other. Shortly before their formal engagement, Anju notices a change in Amarnath - as he appears to be drifting further from her. Then he decides to demolish his house and re-built it, and also refuses to go near any Mandir - either alone or in Anju's company. When part of the house collapses, he is injured, but recuperates quickly. It is then the town is set afire with rumors that Amarnath may have sexually molested a village belle named Sonia, who sells milk, lives a poor lifestyle with her widowed dad, cruel step-mother, and is to be married to the village goon, Shankar. Watch what happens when Shankar gets killed, and Sonia is arrested for killing him.

Title: 289. Mambo
description: Silvana Mangano (a very lovely and sexy voiced actress) plays a young, poor Venetian woman, Giovanna Masetti. She is struggling with a difficult life as a shop assistant when one day the young count Enrico sees her in the glass shop where she works.

Title: 290. This or That
description: An ex-convict gets a job as a taxi driver to change his girlfriend's prejudiced father's view of him, and becomes embroiled with a criminal gang in the process.

Title: 291. The Sheep Has Five Legs
description: A small town seeking publicity tries to bring together the quintuplet grandsons of the town's oldest inhabitant.

Title: 292. Trader Tom of the China Seas
293. Where Is Freedom?
description: A barber compelled by jealousy to commit murder spends 20 years in jail. But when he's released he cannot adapt to a changed world and the hypocrisy of his relatives, so he decides to return to prison.

Title: 294. Flying Classroom
description: All is not really well between the boys of Gymnasium and the boys of the six-form High School: sparks fly when they get within 100m of each other. The continuous feud between the pupils is only one of the pleasant alternations, which life brings into the everyday school life. In addition, there are the rehearsals for the school theatre, and there are the secrets around a teacher called 'Justus' and a man called 'Nichtraucher' or the "non-smoker" since he lives in an abandoned non-smoking railway carriage. In between all the exciting surprises, a few serious things remain to be done.

Title: 295. Jungle Gents
description: When the boys discover that Sach has a strange ability to sniff out diamonds, they hatch a scheme to make money out of it.

Title: 296. Accadde al commissariato
description: Everyday all kind of people pass through a Police Station, especially if it is downtown. Today, however, the chief of police has bought his first car and he has decided to test it with his wife going to Ostia. But first a theatrical company sent out of the theatre, last Alfredo Todini arrested while walking wearing a gown and in the mean a series of human cases, ranging from the pathetic to the funny one, get in the way of his wish.

Title: 297. Black Horse Canyon
description: The story of a wild black stallion and the cowboys who set out to capture him.

Title: 298. New Faces
description: Ronny Graham is in trouble on opening night because a big check is due before the curtain can go up. A wealthy Texan says he will put up the money since his daughter is in the show - but he wants to see the show first.

Title: 299. Go Man Go
description: The story of Abe Saperstein and the creation of the Harlem Globetrotters.

Title: 300. El rapto
description: Ricardo Alfaro, rich rancher of a small town disappears without a trace. Taking advantage of this, Aurora Campos purchase his properties, but when Ricardo reappears a battle is triggered.

Title: 301. Playgirl
description: A naive Nebraska girl dreams of success in New York where she immerses herself in the glitzy glamorous life of the nightlife and the nightclubs frequented by rich playboys, but murder and manipulative people eventually burst her bubble.

Title: 302. Shaytan al-Sahra
description: After a tyrant kills a tribesman, Essam avenges him, rescues Dalal, and conceals his identity. Exposed but undeterred, he rallies warriors, defeats the tyrant, and rises to power, marrying Dalal.

Title: 303. A Day in Court
description: A day at an Italian trial court, where a magistrate judges a full array of peculiar petty crimes and characters.

Title: 304. Jubilee Trail
description: A wild west trader and his New York City wife head out for California by wagon train. The trader is killed en route, and his wife finds herself pregnant. She continues on, hoping to find a man and a home.

Title: 305. An Inn at Osaka
description: Follows the story of an insurance company executive from Tokyo, Mr. Mito, who is demoted to the Osaka office. He takes a room at a small inn and tries to rebuild his life.

Title: 306. Ernst Thalmann: Son of the Working Class
description: This historical-biographical film begins in the first days of November 1918 on the western front. News comes to the soldiers of a revolutionary uprising in Kiel. Young Thälmann, a soldier against his will, would like to join the expanding conflict on the side of his comrades in Hamburg. As the revolution becomes threatened by the betrayal of the right-wing Social Democrats and the splintering of the working class, he nevertheless tries unremittingly to unite the workers. The reactionaries grow ever stronger and the neediness of ordinary people multiplies. In this dire situation, the Hamburg police commissioner would like to block the unloading of a ship full of provisions that were sent from Petrograd as a message of solidarity. But Thälmann prevails in unloading it. The high point and conclusion of the first part of the Thälmann films is established at the Hamburg Uprising in October 1923.

Title: 307. Svengali
description: The story of a genius who hypnotizes an artist's model into becoming a great concert singer, and how she escapes from his influence only by his death.

Title: 308. El mil amores
description: Viviano le compra su casa a Carmen y ella aprovecha para hacerlo pasar por padre de su hija Patricia, para que en el colegio de la joven lo conozcan y sus compañeras no se burlen de ella por no tener papá.

Title: 309. Prisoner of War
description: During the Korean War, an American officer is tasked with infiltrating a Communist-run POW camp in order to investigate the treatment of American prisoners by the enemy.

Title: 310. The Deadly Game
description: An American on vacation in Spain gets mixed up with a smuggling ring.

Title: 311. The Woman of Rumour
description: Yukiko's mother runs a lodging house for courtesans in Kyoto. When her fiance learns this, he ends their engagement. Yukiko despises what her mother does until one of her mother's clients shows interest in her and starts to woo her.

Title: 312. The Boy from Oklahoma
description: Corrupt mayor Barney Turlock appoints lawyer-wannabe greenhorn Tom Brewster as sheriff but regrets his choice when Brewster becomes efficient at fighting crime and solves the murder of the previous sheriff.

Title: 313. The Gambler from Natchez
description: In New Orleans, discharged army Captain Vance Colby learns of his father's killing done by three local Creole gents at a card game, and he sets out to punish the killers.

Title: 314. Serpent Island
description: An office secretary from Scranton, Pennsylvania (Mary Munday) sets out to find her great-grandfather's hidden treasure. She enlists the aid of a former Marine Engineer turned harbor bum (Sonny Tufts) and the greedy captain (Tom Monroe) of the sea ship "Constellation". They find the gold hidden on an island near Haiti, but it's guarded by a voodoo cult and a boa constrictor.

Title: 315. Jesse James' Women
description: Jesse James keeps so busy skirt-chasing that his outlaw career starts to suffer.

Title: 316. This Is My Love
description: Vida, an unstable young woman, is stuck in a loveless marriage to a bitter, crippled man. When her younger sister pays a visit with her new boyfriend, Vida sets her sights on the handsome young man.

Title: 317. Arrow in the Dust
description: A cavalry deserter risks his life to warn and protect a wagon train from an impending Indian attack.

Title: 318. El beso de Judas
description: The story of Judas's betrayal of Christ.

Title: 319. The Art of Getting Along
description: Rosario Scimoni is twenty years old and lives in Catania at the beginning of this century. He loves two things in life: women and money and he is the secretary of the mayor who is his uncle, and the lover of the mayor's wife, but, unfortunately, he isn't paid for neither of his two jobs. When Rosario falls in love with Paola, partner af a socialist, he becames socialist and let the man of Paola go to jail to have her, but he has no success. When Mussolini and his fascists take the power, Rosario found himself fascist and he marries a women ugly but rich. He becames a gerarca (high fascist authority). When during World War II Sicily is invaded by the allied troops he camouflages himself as communist and at the end of the war he goes to Rome after losing all the money he had. In Rome Rosario changes again his skin and becames a Chistian Democrat after the Christian Democrat's victory in the elections of 1948. Trying to speculate on the land near Rome he ends in prison for five years and in 1953 Rosario closes his career dressed as a German selling faked German gadgets in the streets of Rome.

Title: 320. Morena Clara
description: A gipsy girl and her uncle are judged for the theft of several hams. Some time later, she ends up working in the house of her former prosecutor...

Title: 321. Loves of Three Queens
description: At a wedding party involving three beautiful women, a young man should choose the most charming. But a professor intervenes to prevent the verdict, remembering the troubles caused by Paris in a similar situation.

Title: 322. Somewhere Under the Broad Sky
description: A family in the city of Tokyo running a liquor store overcome their impotence and dysfunction as they induce an understanding through each other of how to deal with their individual problems.

Title: 323. The Bamboo Prison
description: Corporal Brady (Brian Keith) an American soldier captured during the Korean War, is taken to a POW camp. There he meets Sergeant Rand (Robert Francis) a prisoner who is cooperating with the North Koreans. Brady is disgusted by these actions, but he soon discovers that Rand is really an intelligence officer playing along to access important secrets. Rand also becomes close to Tanya Clayton (Dianne Foster), the wife of an American traitor, in order to exact information.

Title: 324. Silent Raiders
description: A special unit is dispatched to German-occupied territory just before the Normandy invasion in order to destroy a German communications center.

Title: 325. Letters from My Windmill
description: Consists of four stories from the book of the same name by Alphonse Daudet: "The Three Low Masses", "The Elixir of Father Gaucher", "The Priest of Cucugnan" and "The Secret Of Master Cornille".

Title: 327. Varietease
description: The legendary pinup queen Bettie Page stars in a marvelous burlesque show, alongside '50s icons Lili St.Cryr, Bobby Shields, Chris Le Chris Lynn and many others.

Title: 328. The Queen of Babylon
description: Beautiful goatherd helps Chaldean rebel fight evil king in ancient Babylon.

Title: 329. The Yellow Tomahawk
description: When the army insists on building a fort on Indian land, in defiance of a treaty, the warnings of a scout go unheeded.

Title: 330. Late Chrysanthemums
description: What is the life of a Geisha like once her beauty has faded and she has retired? Kin has saved her money, and has become a wealthy money-lender, spending her days cold-heartedly collecting debts. Even her best friends, Tomi, Nobu, and Tamae, who were her fellow Geisha, are now indebted to her. For all of them, the glamor of their young lives has passed; Tomi and Tamae have children, but their children have disappointed them. Kin has two former lovers who still pursue her; one she wants to see, and the other she doesn't. But even the one she remembers fondly, when he shows up, proves to be a disappointment.

Title: 331. Malaga
description: A female former OSS agent is sent to Tangiers, Morocco, to infiltrate and destroy an international smuggling ring.

Title: 332. April Fools' Day
description: Emile is mechanic in a garage, he saves each month a share of his salary to buy his wife Charlotte a washing machine. Unfortunately, he is "twisted" by a salesman who makes him buy ultra-modern fishing tackle.

Title: 333. Il matrimonio
description: An Italian historical comedy film consisting of three segments, based on three stage plays by Anton Chekhov.

Title: 334. Fireman Save My Child
description: A film intended for Bud Abbott and Lou Costello that ended up starring Hugh O'Brian and Buddy Hackett. Most of the footage was given over to Spike Jones and His City Slickers, about the all hands members of a 1910 fire company about to be mechanized.

Title: 335. Madame du Barry
description: Young Jeanne Bécu becomes mistress to Count du Barry, who facilitates her becoming King Louis XV's mistress by arranging a sham marriage. She reigns at Versailles until the King's death, then is exiled and later executed by guillotine.

Title: 336. The Good Soldier Schweik
description: Adapting Jaroslav Hasek's raucous satirical novel, and also bringing Josef Lada's equally famous illustrations to garrulous puppet life, posed Trnka one of his biggest creative challenges. Trnka himself felt that the final episode was the most artistically successful, but there's much to enjoy in all three, not least the way that the lackadaisical layabout Svejk's own self-serving anecdotes are realized through cut-out animation.

Title: 337. Illusion Travels by Streetcar
description: Confronted with the unfortunate news that their favorite streetcar, Number 133, will be decommissioned, two Municipal Transit workers get drunk and decide to "take 'er for one last spin."

Title: 338. So This Is Paris
description: Three sailors on leave (Joe, Al and Davy) head for Paris with one thing on their minds. Joe pursues chanteuse Colette D'Avril who proves to be more than she appears; Davy is pursued by sexy cashier Yvonne; but the blonde Al rescues from a purse snatcher rewards him with kisses, then vanishes without telling him her name. Romantic complications and resolutions follow in true musical comedy fashion.

Title: 340. Avanzi di galera
description: Three prisoners are discharged from jail: Stefano Luprandi, a surgeon accused of murdering a patient by doing an unauthorized surgery, Giuseppe Rasi, unjustly processed for robbery, and Franco Cesari, a thief. Once released, Stefano loses all confidence in himself: despite the support of his loving wife, he wants to leave her. But then his wife suffers a serious car accident and he must save her and regains confidence in life. Giuseppe, who has always declared he is innocent, is released early for good behavior, but finds misunderstanding everywhere. A young nurse comes to the rescue and with her love and confidence saves him from depression. Francos destiny wont be as happy as the other two when he tries to recover the gold he stole.

Title: 342. Obsession
description: A diabolic suspense which never gives the viewer any respite....Shall Helene save her husband? But it may mean sending an innocent man to the guillotine..

Title: 343. Masterson of Kansas
description: In Kansas, fearing another Indian War, Sheriff Bat Masterson, Marshal Wyatt Earp and Doc Holliday join forces to defuse tensions over grazing lands between Indians and greedy cattlemen.

Title: 344. The Scheming Women
description: Paul Rémi, the well-known theater director, was accused by his secretary, Andrieux, of having pushed his associate Bazine from a footbridge situated twelve meters above the stage. Advised by his wife Mona, he hides in a psychiatric hospital.

Title: 345. Father, Mother, the Maid and I
description: The film tells how a young lawyer Robert Langlois fell in love with a student Catherine and how they both managed to "tame" their parents and get their consent to marriage.

Title: 346. Jesse James vs. the Daltons
description: The son of Jesse James joins up with the notorious Dalton gang.

Title: 347. Cross-Up
description: News reporter John Desmond acquires operative Anna Ray's contact list after her shooting. Her criminal organization pursues him, entangling him in their illegal activities and a perilous chase.

Title: 348. Amori di mezzo secolo
description: Anthology of tragic love. A noblewoman falls for a commoner. A doctor keeps quiet about his patients' infidelities. Expectant father is sent to fight in WWI. A 1920s fascist enjoys Rome's nightlife. WWII airman falls for a girl in Naples.

Title: 349. Front Page Story
description: Grant is the news editor of London's "Daily World". On a very complicated day, two news stories come to a dramatic climax. Interwoven with these is the problem of Grant's personal life which looks likely to become yet another news item.

Title: 350. Miss Nitouche
description: Denise discovered that Celestin leads a double life: he composes operetta night for his mistress, a young singer named Corinne.

Title: 353. Cannibal Attack
description: Johnny Weissmuller fights enemy agents who are trying to steal cobalt while disguised as crocodiles.

Title: 354. Captain Kidd and the Slave Girl
description: Anthony Dexter---bare-chested most of the film with the smoldering nostrils from "Valentino"---as "Captain Kidd" is saved from hanging by an earl who wants to get his hand on Kidd's treasure. The earl thinks the best method is to put a woman confederate, Eva Gabor (Judith Duvall) aboard Kidd's ship as a slave girl to wrest or wrestle the information from him. They fight a lot as a prelude to falling in love, and then work together against the evil earl's none-too-well laid plan. Alan Hale, Jr. (Simpson) is along as Kidd's trusted friend, while Sonia Sorel (as Ann Bonney) displays a lot of what the best-undressed female pirate wasn't wearing on pirate ships of the time.

Title: 355. The Black Dakotas
description: During the American Civil War, Confederate spies aim to steal Union gold intended for the peace treaty with the Sioux and thus pit the Indians against the Union Forces.

Title: 356. Karin Månsdotter
description: The movie starts with a silent section of slapsticks in BLUE and white and with piano music, giving an outline of Karin's rise and fall. The rest is normal B&W movie. Karin does not belong to the nobility but nevertheless marries the mentally ill king Erik XIV and becomes queen of Sweden. The king's skilled counsellor Göran Persson wants a royal policy supporting the people and supported by it. But in relation to the nobility the king oscillates between provocative strength and unpredictable weakness. Göran arranges that some very powerful noblemen are killed. Subsequently the king tries to have them convicted of high treason by the parliament. He forgets the manuscript, mixes up all facts, and the noblemen are acquitted. But Göran speedily gathers another parliament and has them convicted. Meanwhile Erik apologises because of the unjust murders. Hence Erik is dethroned and imprisoned. Göran is executed. Karin is restricted to a castle in Finland. In the prison Erik believes that he is still the king and gives the guards presents such as all fishes in the Baltic Sea.

Title: 357. Night of Love
description: Two brothers, a hero and a coward .

Title: 358. Naughty New Orleans
